thread:
nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a short customer note + statuspage update and clear owners for RCA sharing. Who can pick which piece?

leo: I9ll take the status page bullet. Will propose plain language line by tomorrow morning.

rachel: I can draft the customer-facing summary (two-paragraph, non-technical) and will include an explicit timeline for the RCA. Suggest: publish summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days. Any objections?

david: Sounds reasonable. For RCA sharing, we should require account consent before sending sanitized logs. Public summary can be published by default. I9ll draft a one-pager with the redaction rules and consent wording.

carla: I9ll own the tracking sheet and will create JIRA tasks for each action. Please add ticket numbers to the tracker when you create them. Also can we set a single point-of-contact for CS so they know who to escalate to?

ops-bot: Created tickets: IN-9012 (statuspage copy) -> leo, due 2025-12-08; IN-9013 (customer summary) -> rachel, due 2025-12-07; IN-9014 (RCA redaction policy + consent) -> david, due 2025-12-10; IN-9015 (recurring-patterns analysis) -> nina, due 2025-12-15.

nina: For statuspage text, keep it short: "We experienced intermittent write latency impacting a small number of customers. We mitigated impact and are investigating root cause; a detailed RCA will be published within 7 days." Leo, please post your suggested edit but keep it customer-focused, not technical.

leo: Draft posted to tracker: "Intermittent write latency affected a small subset of customers. We enacted mitigation steps to reduce impact and are continuing our investigation. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Feedback welcome.

rachel: Slight tweak: change "a small subset" to "a few customers" per CS preference. Also added the two-paragraph customer summary to the tracker (summary + next steps + contact).

david: Drafted the redaction appendix: remove explicit customer IDs, IPs, and internal hostnames; keep anonymized timelines and aggregated metrics. Consent checkbox mock added: "I consent to receive sanitized logs for troubleshooting."

carla: All JIRA links added to the tracker. Marking IN-9012/9013 as in-progress. I'll send a brief note to CS with owners and ticket links so account teams know how to request logs.

nina: Two process questions: 1) If owners miss the timeline, do we automatically publish the interim summary? 2) Are enterprise customers handled differently?

leo: If owners miss commit, ops should post the agreed interim summary + statuspage link to customers. For enterprise customers with custom SLAs, escalate to legal/account and consider delaying public detail until consent is resolved.

david: Agree. For enterprise accounts, add a one-line flag in the tracker so CS knows to route communications through AM/legal.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping thread in 48 hours if tickets still open.

rachel: Noted. I9ll get the summary published once legal quick-approves the wording (expect <24h).

nina: Thanks — please keep updates short here. Carla, ping me when IN-9015 analysis is ready; I want the recurring-pattern recommendations before next sprint planning.

carla: Will do. Added calendar slot for "Recurrence review" next Tuesday.

[end of thread]
